attackers_goals: Attackers may export certificates to .pfx files to use them for authentication, persistence or NTLM extraction.
description: PowerShell was used to extract a pfx certificate file.
investigative_actions: Check if the pfx creation is legitimate for the user (Testing, IT, etc.). Follow further actions done by the user (ex. authentication using certificates).
name: PowerShell pfx certificate extraction
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
